title: ModelFlowStepCompletion
description: Canonical JSON contract for auditable completion evidence of a linear flow step in jocaagura_domain.

stepIndex.description: Index of the completed step inside the embedded flow.

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the operator confirms the completion of the step.

evidenceUrl.description: Optional URL that points to supporting evidence of the completed step.

notes.description: Optional observation captured for auditability of the completed step.
